mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 85 degrees with partly cloudy skies near Harriet Park, a full moon in the sky, and an overnight low of 66 degrees with no rain predicted.

The city has announced road surface treatments on Lincoln Street beginning August 4, and residents are reminded that a rebate program is available if you replace older toilets with high-efficiency models.
There is plenty to do today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and trivia at Hop Haus, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
Looking at the weekly report, on July 26, an officer stopped a vehicle traveling 97 miles per hour, resulting in an arrest for an O W I offence.
Culver's is serving up Caramel Turtle today, and you can also find Kona Ice at Fireman's Park until 4:30 PM and McGaw Park until 7 PM today.
